reason: A is marginally better because it advances a more causally testable mediator—microstructural heterogeneities—and proposes an annealed comparison intended to challenge that mechanism, whereas B largely tests the already-expected difference between room-temperature and hot-salt exposure without isolating salt-flux attack from ordinary thermal oxidation. A still needs stronger controls and a better intervention, since homogenizing annealing will not remove inclusions and may independently change grain structure and oxide formation.
